image_description: A full-body side profile of an American Bison standing on a gravel path. The bison has a massive, dark brown shaggy coat covering the head, neck, and forequarters, forming a distinct shoulder hump. The hindquarters are less furred with shorter hair. It has short, curved horns, a beard under the chin, and sturdy legs ending in hooves. In the background, other bison are visible grazing in a green field.
